title: Builders in Kolathur: Narrow Lanes, Small Plots, Multi-Floor Homes

seo.metaTitle: Builders in Kolathur | House Construction | Hunter Property
seo.metaDescription: House construction in Kolathur from our corporate office here: narrow-lane access, G+1 and G+2 designs for small plots and demolition priced line by line.

excerpt: Building in Kolathur usually means a narrow lane, a small plot and an old house to remove first. This guide covers what that does to access, structure and cost, from the team at our Kolathur corporate office.
faqTitle: Building in Kolathur: questions owners ask

faqs.question: Is your Kolathur office close to my site?
faqs.answer: Our corporate office is in Kolathur, and our head office in Perambur and branch in Sembiam are nearby. Kolathur sites are supervised from close at hand, which matters on narrow-lane jobs where small decisions happen fast.

faqs.question: What do your house construction packages cost in Kolathur?
faqs.answer: Our packages are priced per sq ft of built-up area: Basic ₹2,199, Standard ₹2,399, Premium ₹2,699 and Ultra Luxury ₹3,199. Approvals, soil test, compound wall, sump and interiors are quoted separately. Where the lane blocks a transit mixer we show the access premium as a named line, and demolition and debris disposal are listed separately when an older house is coming down.

faqs.question: Who approves a new house in Kolathur?
faqs.answer: For a typical individual house in Kolathur, the building permit comes from the Greater Chennai Corporation; larger buildings go to CMDA. We prepare the drawings and handle the submission, with the approval fees quoted separately.

faqs.question: Can I build the ground floor now and add floors later?
faqs.answer: Yes, if the foundation and columns are designed for the final number of floors from the start. Our structural drawings in Kolathur assume the top floor even when it will be built years later, because strengthening footings afterwards costs more than the floor.

faqs.question: Where do scaffolding and materials go on a tight Kolathur plot?
faqs.answer: Scaffolding stays inside your boundary, and with little space to stack, materials arrive in smaller, more frequent loads. That shapes how the external finishing is sequenced and adds handling cost, which we show in the quote.
